coverage.CGC: 42 DriverMONI positives used as paper-attributed v95 subset at user request; full export unavailable, extraction and tiers unverified
coverage.OncoKB: Full public gene-list and somatic/germline curated-gene exports; tumour/alteration-level export requires authorization and was not acquired
coverage.IntOGen: Complete downloaded compendium, unfiltered assertions and cohort metadata; BRCA records selected by exact cancer code
coverage.literature: Literature spot-check from the BRCA label audit; not an exhaustive review or a CGC reconstruction.

limits: IntOGen advertised filename, archive directory and README release disagree; all labels and hashes are preserved rather than silently choosing a version.
Gene-status decisions are evidence reviews, not a new training-label export; all original positives remain unchanged.
No confirmed gene-level negatives are asserted. Rejected IntOGen calls and germline non-association findings are not somatic negative labels.
Shared publications and patient overlap are not fully resolved; database/cohort counts are not counts of independent validations.
OncoKB summary mentions and therapeutic levels do not establish alteration oncogenicity or somatic BRCA specificity.
